name: FindMyBus
tagline: View public transport vehicle positions real time
blurb: An app to view public transport vehicle positions on a map in real time, utilizing a GTFS Realtime feed.
description:
An app to view public transport vehicle positions on a map in real time, utilizing a GTFS Realtime feed.

Features:

• Visualize GTFS Realtime feeds on a map

• See live positions of vehicles and extra information about them, such as their timetables

• Light data usage
